summary.text: Says Dexter will fight for working families by supporting living wages, union jobs, and affordable housing and childcare.
summary.quote: Working families, not billionaires: Good schools, living wages, union jobs, affordable housing and childcare.

summary.text: Says Dexter believes healthcare is a human right and supports accessible, affordable care, including abortion, vaccinations, and gender-affirming care.
summary.quote: Healthcare is a human right: High quality, accessible and affordable care for all. Keep politicians out of exam rooms and let science guide care. Abortion, vaccinations and gender-affirming care are healthcare.

summary.text: Says Dexter has secured $14M for community-led projects and helped Oregonians recover millions from the federal government.
summary.quote: Secured $14M for community-led projects, Helped Oregonians recover millions owed to them by the federal government,
